note: Day 1 morning lines. Written by Content Writer. Keys under 'steps' match the setStep ids in src/world/morning.js so Game Dev can look lines up by id. 'bubble' is a speech bubble (who says it), 'caption' is a narration line, 'move' is the on-screen motion cue. No balance numbers live here: effects stay in the game code and activities.csv. Roommate is Zanele, the bestie the player meets in person.

goal.text: Get to your 9:00 lecture on time.
goal.hint: Eat something, catch the bus, make it to campus.
goal.met: You made it. 9:00 and you are already winning.
goal.failed: Late. The lecturer notices. So does everyone else.

zanele.name: Zanele
zanele.role: Roommate in O Block. Your bestie from day one.
zanele.look: Oversized hoodie, one earbud in, hair wrapped for the night and not quite unwrapped.
zanele.intro: That is Zanele. She will borrow things all year and return them with interest.
zanele.wave: Morning, roomie! I’m Zanele 👋 Alarm’s about to go.

wake.caption: O Block, 07:00. Your phone buzzes on the pillow. Your stomach buzzes louder.

zanele.text: Mm. You snoozed {n} times. I counted. We are going to be friends.

wake.move: Blanket slides off, stripe of sun crosses the floor, Zanele rolls over in the other bed.
wake.question: Alarm! Get up or snooze?

kettle.caption: Four steps to the kettle. It is a small room and a long walk.

kettle-walk.caption: Slippers squeak across the tiles. Somebody else is already heading to the kettle.

zanele_walks_over.text: Wait, I was first. I can smell it.

noodles.caption: Masala flavour. The kettle clicks, steam curls up, and the day is going well.

zanele.text: Save me the flavour sachet. I will pay you in gossip.

roommate.caption: The cupboard is empty. Zanele is standing there with the wrapper and a very guilty smile.

bubble.text: Sorry! Last packet 😅 I’ll buy more later.

roommate.introduction: Hi, I am Zanele. We are doing this properly now. I owe you noodles and one (1) apology.
roommate.move: Zanele steps in with the wrapper, crinkles it, gives you the biggest sorry eyes.
roommate.bare: The shelf is bare. Your roommate got the last packet.

caf_later.bubble: Caf pap on campus. Hold on, stomach.

caf-later.caption: Breakfast can wait for the caf on campus. Your stomach disagrees.

caf-breakfast.caption: Off the bus and straight into the caf queue. Pap and egg, R30.

tuckshop.caption: Down the corridor, past three people in towels. The tuck shop auntie is smiling.

bubble.text: Noodles? Last one, my girl. Hurry, the bell is coming.

zanele_after.text: I will pay you back on NSFAS day. Pinky promise.

skip.caption: Your stomach files a complaint and copies in your wallet.

zanele.text: Take this biscuit. Do not tell anyone I am a nice person.

door.prompt: 🚪 Head out to the bus stop
door.caption: Bag, student card, charger. In that order, because panic has an order.

exit.caption: Door, stairwell, sunshine. The whole block smells of toast and ambition.

zanele_at_door.text: Go go go! Save me a seat at the back if we have the same class.

to-stop.caption: Past the res gate and the vendors setting up. Someone says "Morning, sisi" and means it.

walk-stop.caption: Flip-flops, vendors, a dog trotting across the road like it has a lecture too.

stop.caption: A small queue. Everyone checks their phone and pretends not to look at the road.

bus-arriving.caption: Here it comes, wheezing like it has done this a thousand times. It has.

board.caption: Doors fold open. The queue surges. You surge with it.

boarding.caption: Window seat, bag on your knees. A speaker three rows back is playing amapiano.

riding.caption: Campus slides past the glass. A student dozes with their head on the window.

arrive.caption: The gate, the Quad, the crowd streaming toward the lecture venues.

on_time.title: You made it to campus
on_time.line: {min} minutes to find your venue and a seat.

late.title: You made it… just
late.line: You slip in after it started. −2 Grades.

hungry.bubble: No breakfast, no problem. Probably. Bus, here I come.

bus_late.caption: The bus coughs, stops at a red robot, and sits there. You watch 08:45 go by.

bubble.text: Come on, come on, come ON.

zanele_text.text: Where are you? Lecturer already looks angry.

snoozed_too_long.caption: You snoozed one too many. The kettle never even gets a chance.

zanele.text: I let you sleep. I regret it. Run.

missed_bus.caption: The bus pulls away as you round the corner. You wave. It does not wave back.

tap_feedback: Footsteps trail behind you for a second.
Your bag bounces against your back.
A taxi hoots like it has an opinion.

sipho.name: Sipho
sipho.role: Roommate in O Block for a male student. Your bestie from day one.
sipho.look: Blue varsity jacket over a vest, one sock on, phone already at 12%.
sipho.intro: That is Sipho. He has a plan for everything except mornings.
sipho.note: Sipho has his own lines. Keys mirror the Zanele ones they replace (path in the morning code -> Sipho line).

lines.zanele.wave: Ayy, roomie! I’m Sipho 👊 Your alarm is about to scream.
lines.steps.wake.zanele: Snoozed {n} times, bra. I was keeping score.
lines.late_variants.snoozed_too_long.zanele: I tried, my guy. You fought the alarm and lost. Go!
lines.steps.roommate.bubble: Eish, sorry! Last packet 😅 I’ll sort you out at lunch.
lines.steps.roommate.bare: The shelf is empty. Sipho is holding the last packet like a trophy.
